title: Emerson, Lake & Palmer (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released by Island on 20 November 1970, recorded at Advision in July 1970. "Knife-Edge" from the first movement of Janáček's Sinfonietta with a quotation of Bach's French Suite No. 1; "Tank", Palmer's solo spot, composed with Emerson: a first section with clavinet, piano and bass, a drum solo in the middle, clavinet and Moog to end. Personnel: Carl Palmer, drums and percussion.

title: Trilogy (Emerson, Lake & Palmer album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released by Island on 23 June 1972, recorded at Advision from September 1971. "Hoedown", from Copland's Rodeo with his permission, opened their shows from 1972 to 1974; "The Sheriff" leads into it with a drum solo. Personnel: Carl Palmer, drums and percussion.
